summary: Solve the frequency matrix or Harris descriptor with explicit residual, cancellation and infinite-mode taxonomy; retain complete near-pole carriers.

identity.direction: Declared inputs to named scientific outputs.
identity.definition: Dense/sp0 eig or shifted sparse/sp1 eigs for ES1D/EM, complex128 eigenpairs and normalized backward residual. Generic ES3D homogeneous descriptor exposes alpha,beta and infinite/canceled modes and rejects unqualified finite roots. Positive perpendicular ES uses nearest-pole signed offset interlacing at80 decimal digits; decimal base+offset carries sub-ulp displacement. Rounded omega/plots are incomplete carriers.
identity.model: Nonrelativistic Gaussian species; explicit finite-harmonic/rational approximation when applicable.
identity.geometry: Homogeneous plasma with background field along z; k=(kx,0,kz) where applicable.
identity.coordinates: Explicit ES dimensionless normalization or EM SI; complex frequency follows exp(-i omega t).
identity.boundary: Periodic/infinite homogeneous plane-wave response; finite numerical harmonic/pole representation explicitly declared.
assumptions: A numerical spectrum is not automatically a physically certified mode.

inputs.name: matrix
inputs.description: ES1D/EM square matrix, or complete ES3D point state.
inputs.constraints: Finite and representable in the declared numeric type.

inputs.name: sp
inputs.description: Dense0 or shifted sparse1 for ES1D/EM.
inputs.constraints: For ES1D/EM, integer 0 or 1; ignored by ES3D descriptor/interlacing branches.

inputs.name: nw
inputs.description: Requested sparse count, default1; must be less than dimension-1.
inputs.constraints: For sparse ES1D/EM only: None selects 1, otherwise integer >=1 and <matrix dimension-1; ignored for dense and ES3D.

inputs.name: wg
inputs.constraints: Finite complex128 scalar when consumed by sparse ES1D/EM; ignored for dense and ES3D.

outputs.name: omega
outputs.description: ES1D/EM raw d alias; generic ES3D accepted roots sorted by growth; perpendicular ES3D binary64 rounded real roots.
outputs.units: ES dimensionless frequency or EM rad s^-1
outputs.constraints: Returned on successful completion; this diagnostic does not independently certify physical applicability.

outputs.name: d
outputs.description: Unsorted eigenvalues; omega aliases d.
outputs.units: ES dimensionless frequency or EM rad s^-1
outputs.constraints: Present for ES1D/EM only; raw eigenpair diagnostics use the d/V column order, not growth-sorted order.

outputs.name: V
outputs.description: Right eigenvectors aligned with unsorted d.
outputs.constraints: Present for ES1D/EM only; raw eigenpair diagnostics use the d/V column order, not growth-sorted order.

outputs.name: wi
outputs.description: Imaginary parts of growth-sorted w.
outputs.units: ES dimensionless frequency or EM rad s^-1
outputs.constraints: Present for ES1D/EM only; raw eigenpair diagnostics use the d/V column order, not growth-sorted order.

outputs.name: ind
outputs.description: Stable descending-imaginary permutation of unsorted d.
outputs.constraints: Present for ES1D/EM only; raw eigenpair diagnostics use the d/V column order, not growth-sorted order.

outputs.name: indices
outputs.description: Literal zero-based index convention.
outputs.constraints: Present for ES1D/EM only; raw eigenpair diagnostics use the d/V column order, not growth-sorted order.

outputs.name: backward_residual
outputs.description: Normalized matrix eigenpair residual for each unsorted d/V column.
outputs.constraints: Present for ES1D/EM only; raw eigenpair diagnostics use the d/V column order, not growth-sorted order.

outputs.name: wg
outputs.description: Growth-first root w[0], returned even for dense solve.
outputs.units: ES dimensionless frequency or EM rad s^-1
outputs.constraints: Present for ES1D/EM only; raw eigenpair diagnostics use the d/V column order, not growth-sorted order.

outputs.name: w
outputs.description: ES1D/EM stable descending-imaginary ordering of d; perpendicular ES3D deterministic real-frequency ordering.
outputs.units: ES dimensionless frequency or EM rad s^-1
outputs.constraints: Present for ES1D/EM and perpendicular ES3D; generic ES3D exposes its sorted roots as omega.

outputs.name: all_finite
outputs.description: All finite generalized eigenvalues before rational qualification.
outputs.constraints: Present for generic ES3D descriptor/constant branches; absent on exact-perpendicular ES3D.

outputs.name: infinite_count
outputs.description: Count of beta==0 generalized eigenvalues; constant branch returns zero.
outputs.constraints: Present for generic ES3D descriptor/constant branches; absent on exact-perpendicular ES3D.

outputs.name: canceled_poles
outputs.description: Exactly coincident pole groups whose combined residue is exactly zero.
outputs.constraints: Present for generic ES3D descriptor/constant branches; absent on exact-perpendicular ES3D.

outputs.name: rational_residual
outputs.description: Normalized represented rational-equation residual for all_finite.
outputs.constraints: Present for generic ES3D descriptor/constant branches; absent on exact-perpendicular ES3D.

outputs.name: pencil_residual
outputs.description: Normalized generalized eigenpair residual for all_finite.
outputs.constraints: Present for generic ES3D descriptor/constant branches; absent on exact-perpendicular ES3D.

outputs.name: constant
outputs.description: Dimensionless constant after coefficient validation.
outputs.constraints: Present for generic ES3D descriptor/constant branches; absent on exact-perpendicular ES3D.

outputs.name: poles
outputs.description: Exactly combined nonzero-residue pole groups.
outputs.constraints: Present for generic ES3D descriptor/constant branches; absent on exact-perpendicular ES3D.

outputs.name: residues
outputs.description: Combined residues aligned with poles.
outputs.constraints: Present for generic ES3D descriptor/constant branches; absent on exact-perpendicular ES3D.

outputs.name: accepted
outputs.description: Qualification mask aligned with all_finite; public solve raises with attached diagnostics if any finite root is rejected.
outputs.constraints: Present only for generic ES3D with a nonzero combined residue; absent for constant and perpendicular branches.

outputs.name: alpha
outputs.description: Homogeneous generalized eigenvalue numerator, including infinite modes.
outputs.constraints: Present only for generic ES3D with a nonzero combined residue; absent for constant and perpendicular branches.

outputs.name: beta
outputs.description: Homogeneous denominator; exact zero identifies a constraint/infinite eigenvalue.
outputs.constraints: Present only for generic ES3D with a nonzero combined residue; absent for constant and perpendicular branches.

outputs.name: A
outputs.description: Reduced frequency descriptor after exact grouping/cancellation.
outputs.constraints: Present only for generic ES3D with a nonzero combined residue; absent for constant and perpendicular branches.

outputs.name: H
outputs.description: Singular descriptor multiplier with zero algebraic field row.
outputs.constraints: Present only for generic ES3D with a nonzero combined residue; absent for constant and perpendicular branches.

outputs.name: classification
outputs.description: String taxonomy: IDENTICALLY_ZERO, NONZERO_CONSTANT_NO_ROOTS, DESCRIPTOR_WITH_EXPLICIT_ROOT_QUALIFICATION, or PERPENDICULAR_INTERLACING_NEAREST_POLE_OFFSET_CARRIER. Detailed perpendicular counts are in mode_classification.
outputs.constraints: Present for ES3D only.

outputs.name: frequency_base
outputs.description: Binary64 nearest reference-pole frequency base.
outputs.constraints: Present only for exact-perpendicular ES3D positive-Gaussian interlacing branch.

outputs.name: frequency_offset
outputs.description: Binary64 signed displacement from that base; decimal pair remains authoritative for sub-ulp modes.
outputs.constraints: Present only for exact-perpendicular ES3D positive-Gaussian interlacing branch.

outputs.name: frequency_base_decimal
outputs.description: Canonical signed nearest-pole frequency base. Pair base and offset; rounded omega alone is incomplete.
outputs.constraints: Present only for exact-perpendicular ES3D positive-Gaussian interlacing branch.

outputs.name: frequency_offset_decimal
outputs.description: Canonical signed sub-ulp displacement from that base. Pair base and offset; rounded omega alone is incomplete.
outputs.constraints: Present only for exact-perpendicular ES3D positive-Gaussian interlacing branch.

outputs.name: published_frequency_base_decimal
outputs.description: Base separately divided by frequency_scale before rounding. Pair base and offset; rounded omega alone is incomplete.
outputs.constraints: Present only for exact-perpendicular ES3D positive-Gaussian interlacing branch.

outputs.name: published_frequency_offset_decimal
outputs.description: Offset separately divided by frequency_scale before rounding. Pair base and offset; rounded omega alone is incomplete.
outputs.constraints: Present only for exact-perpendicular ES3D positive-Gaussian interlacing branch.

outputs.name: published_omega
outputs.description: Binary64 rounded normalized base+offset; public solve uses frequency_scale=1.
outputs.constraints: Present only for exact-perpendicular ES3D positive-Gaussian interlacing branch.

outputs.name: frequency_scale_decimal
outputs.description: Canonical-to-published divisor; public solve default is 1.
outputs.constraints: Present only for exact-perpendicular ES3D positive-Gaussian interlacing branch.

outputs.name: pole_square_decimal
outputs.description: Distinct ordered positive squared cyclotron resonances.
outputs.constraints: Present only for exact-perpendicular ES3D positive-Gaussian interlacing branch.

outputs.name: weights_decimal
outputs.description: Positive residues W of the squared-frequency relation, aligned with poles.
outputs.constraints: Present only for exact-perpendicular ES3D positive-Gaussian interlacing branch.

outputs.name: constant_decimal
outputs.description: Positive finite-Harris constant a.
outputs.constraints: Present only for exact-perpendicular ES3D positive-Gaussian interlacing branch.

outputs.name: root_interval_index
outputs.description: Index of the positive squared-root interval before applying root_sign.
outputs.constraints: Present only for exact-perpendicular ES3D positive-Gaussian interlacing branch.

outputs.name: reference_pole_index
outputs.description: Nearest endpoint pole chart for each returned mode.
outputs.constraints: Present only for exact-perpendicular ES3D positive-Gaussian interlacing branch.

outputs.name: root_sign
outputs.description: Signed frequency branch, -1 or +1.
outputs.constraints: Present only for exact-perpendicular ES3D positive-Gaussian interlacing branch.

outputs.name: square_offset_decimal
outputs.description: Signed x-p_reference displacement in the nearest-endpoint chart.
outputs.constraints: Present only for exact-perpendicular ES3D positive-Gaussian interlacing branch.

outputs.name: shift_chart_residual_decimal
outputs.description: Normalized rational residual evaluated directly in the signed offset chart.
outputs.constraints: Present only for exact-perpendicular ES3D positive-Gaussian interlacing branch.

outputs.name: root_brackets_delta_decimal
outputs.description: Numerical lower/upper signed-offset bounds; not rigorous interval certificates.
outputs.constraints: Present only for exact-perpendicular ES3D positive-Gaussian interlacing branch.

outputs.name: precision_digits
outputs.description: Decimal working precision of the interlacing construction.
outputs.constraints: Present only for exact-perpendicular ES3D positive-Gaussian interlacing branch.

outputs.name: N
outputs.description: Finite retained harmonic cutoff.
outputs.constraints: Present only for exact-perpendicular ES3D positive-Gaussian interlacing branch.

outputs.name: source_pole_order
outputs.description: Source J used for auxiliary alias multiplicities, not additional physical roots.
outputs.constraints: Present only for exact-perpendicular ES3D positive-Gaussian interlacing branch.

outputs.name: mode_count
outputs.description: Number of finite physical signed simple modes, 2*h.
outputs.constraints: Present only for exact-perpendicular ES3D positive-Gaussian interlacing branch.

outputs.name: mode_classification
outputs.description: Counts: source_auxiliary_modes, physical_finite_simple_modes, physical_zero_frequency_modes, zero_residue_source_pole_aliases, repeated_nonzero_source_pole_aliases, total_canceled_source_auxiliary_modes, associated_descriptor_infinite_constraint_modes; associated_descriptor_constructed=False. source_pole_groups stores frequency_decimal, multiplicity and physical_pole per group. Associated infinity is algebraic classification, not a measured eigenvalue from a constructed descriptor.
outputs.constraints: Present only for exact-perpendicular ES3D positive-Gaussian interlacing branch.

outputs.name: precision_limit
outputs.description: Rounded-frequency and decimal-carrier interpretation; numerical brackets are not rigorous intervals.
outputs.constraints: Present only for exact-perpendicular ES3D positive-Gaussian interlacing branch.

preconditions: Constituent inputs finite and representable in declared numeric ports.
supported: Finite represented rational relation, with model-specific residual gates.
Positive perpendicular ES3D returns full source-alias/physical/infinite classification.
excluded: No eigen backward residual alone certifies physical dispersion.
No rigorous interval or universal forward-frequency error bound.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError for invalid model, nonsquare/nonfinite ES1D/EM matrix, unsupported sp, invalid sparse nw or shift; ES3D requires its complete coefficient/carrier state.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: SciPy eig/eigs and Python dependency errors propagate; this operation has no native receipt.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: ArithmeticError on backward residual or descriptor/interlacing qualification failure. Generic ES3D rejected finite modes attach diagnostics to the error. No failed mode is silently accepted.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No successful result is returned if this operation raises; no partial scientific return is promised.

example.description: Bounded executable use of the actual declared scientific ports.
example.code:
from scirel.kinetic.pdrk.rational import equilibrium, pole_table, point_matrix, solve_matrix
eq = equilibrium('es1d', [[1, 1, 1, 1, 0]])['state']
tab = pole_table('es1d', 4)['state']
m = point_matrix('es1d', {**eq, **tab}, k=0.4)['state']['M']
r = solve_matrix(m, model='es1d')
assert len(r['omega']) == 4 and max(r['backward_residual']) <= 1e-11
example.expected: Four represented frequency eigenpairs with backward residual; physical validity requires the separate relation oracle.
